## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A two-juan late-Qīng (Guāngxù-era) *Vajracchedikā* commentary by the layman Xiè Chéngmó (*zì* Guànsān 貫三, sobriquet Pílíng jūshì 毗陵居士 — Pílíng = Chángzhōu, Jiāngsū). Self-prefaced 光緒十五年歲次己丑三月之望 = mid-spring 1889 full-moon = 1889-04-15, with sponsoring prefaces by [唐養愚](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%94%90%E9%A4%8A%E6%84%9A) Táng Yǎngyú (sobriquet Láiyúnzǐ 來雲子, of Pearl-River descent) and [劉紹南](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%8A%89%E7%B4%B9%E5%8D%97) Liú Shàonán (sobriquet Yuánjué jūshì 圓覺居士) of Zhēnzhōu 真州 (Jiāngsū). The catalog credit-line *zhùshì* 註釋 ("annotation-and-explanation") and the title's *yìjiě* 易解 ("easy explanation") together identify the work as a late-Qīng accessible commentary in the *qiǎnjiě* / *yìjiě* devotional-pedagogy genre. *notBefore* / *notAfter* = 1889. Preserved as X25 no. 510. Catalog dynasty 清.

**Abstract**

The opening preface lays out the work's accessibility-rationale: the *Vajracchedikā* is the most circulated Buddhist sūtra "for several thousand years" because its *yán jiǎn yì jīng, nǎi fǎnyuē zhī dào yě* 言簡義精，乃反約之道也 ("language is concise yet meaning is precise — the way of pulling back to the essential"); the present commentary aims to make this precision accessible to general readers. Xiè's prose is plain and direct — characteristic of the late-Qīng Jiāngnán lay-devotional commentary register that bridges the *kǎozhèng*-disciplined commentary of [KR6c0094](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0094) ([俞樾](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%BF%9E%E6%A8%BE) Yú Yuè) and the popular devotional commentary of [KR6c0078](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0078). Xiè also composed a parallel *Bānruò xīnjīng yìjiě*, on the principle that the *Heart Sūtra* condenses the *Vajracchedikā* in capsule form — together they comprise his coordinated *yìjiě* corpus.
